vocabulary.meaning: 最喜欢的；特别喜爱的人/物
可获得的；有空的；可用的；单身的
混凝土；具体的；实在的；使凝固
居住；生活；活的；现场直播的；通电的

examples.text: Playing table tennis helps him to keep healthy.
examples.translation: 打乒乓球有助于他保持健康。
examples.speechText: Playing table tennis helps him to keep healthy.

examples.text: You can watch your favorite（favourite的美式拼写favorite） movie or sports match.
examples.translation: 你可以看自己最喜欢的电影或体育比赛。
examples.speechText: You can watch your favorite movie or sports match.

examples.text: It’s also important to keep a distance from others to help prevent the spread of your illness.
examples.translation: 保持与他人的距离也很重要，有助于防止疾病传播。
examples.speechText: It’s also important to keep a distance from others to help prevent the spread of your illness.

examples.text: Besides, to stop children from using these services just because crimes are being committed online would be like telling them not to attend college because students may have accidents on campus.
examples.translation: 此外，仅仅因为网上有犯罪行为就阻止孩子使用这些服务，就如同因为学生在校园里可能发生意外就不让他们上大学一样。
examples.speechText: Besides, to stop children from using these services just because crimes are being committed online would be like telling them not to attend college because students may have accidents on campus.

examples.text: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.
examples.translation: 现实是，写作是一件孤独、私密而且收入微薄的事情。
examples.speechText: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.

examples.text: The account is attached to a prepaid card that is currently available in Sweden only, but expected to launch elsewhere in Europe in 2020.
examples.translation: 这个账户绑定了一张预付卡；目前该卡仅在瑞典提供，但预计将于2020年在欧洲其他地区推出。
examples.speechText: The account is attached to a prepaid card that is currently available in Sweden only, but expected to launch elsewhere in Europe in 2020.

examples.text: The most recent designs give buildings brains as well as concrete and steel supports.
examples.translation: 最新的设计不仅为建筑提供混凝土和钢材支撑，还赋予建筑“大脑”。
examples.speechText: The most recent designs give buildings brains as well as concrete and steel supports.

examples.text: Their genes passed to future generations.
examples.translation: 它们的基因传给了后代。
examples.speechText: Their genes passed to future generations.

examples.text: Some students may want to travel by car.
examples.translation: 有些学生可能想开车出行。
examples.speechText: Some students may want to travel by car.

examples.text: His last book was completed in 1909, one year before his death.
examples.translation: 他的最后一本书完成于1909年，也就是他去世的前一年。
examples.speechText: His last book was completed in 1909, one year before his death.

examples.text: It doesn’t mean it loves to live in a dark area, though
examples.translation: 不过，这并不意味着它喜欢生活在阴暗的地方。
examples.speechText: It doesn’t mean it loves to live in a dark area, though

examples.text: Honest communication matters（matter的第三人称单数形式） more than perfection.
examples.translation: 坦诚沟通比事事完美更重要。
examples.speechText: Honest communication matters more than perfection.

examples.text: You’ll be late for school again!
examples.speechText: You’ll be late for school again!

examples.text: When we exercise, all of the body’s systems, like muscular and nervous systems, have to communicate with each other more closely than usual.
examples.translation: 我们锻炼时，身体各个系统，如肌肉系统和神经系统，必须比平时更加紧密地相互协调。
examples.speechText: When we exercise, all of the body’s systems, like muscular and nervous systems, have to communicate with each other more closely than usual.

examples.text: If they prove themselves able, they could become guide dogs.
examples.translation: 如果它们证明自己能够胜任，就有可能成为导盲犬。
examples.speechText: If they prove themselves able, they could become guide dogs.
